metaDescription: CA Cluster eggplant is an eggplant variety. About 75 days to harvest, 23.2 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: CA Cluster is a registered eggplant variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1986. UPLB bred it. It takes about 75 days from transplanting to the first harvest, with 23.2 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 23.2 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about CA Cluster eggplant
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

CA Cluster eggplant takes about 75 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 7.5 days faster than the average of the 9 eggplant varieties with a day count, 82.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 23.2 t/ha beats the average of its group, 20.34. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit eggplant fields most often: [eggplant fruit and shoot borer](/pests/eggplant-fruit-and-shoot-borer), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant CA Cluster eggplant

Buyers in each market want their own talong: long and slim and dark purple in most of Luzon, rounder or striped in some towns. Pick a variety with bacterial wilt resistance, and plan for the fruit and shoot borer whatever you plant, because no variety on the market resists it. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 75 days from transplanting to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 23.2 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CA Cluster?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
